'''Dorin pleech''' was a beverage offered by [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Marcus Trant]] to the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] when [[Gender/Legends|he]] and [[Theron Shan]] met with Trant and [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]], though the Jedi Master politely declined the offer.<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>
